about: The reviewed DeepInfra model rows of the preview spending gate (contract A section 1). The gate (packages/providers/ops/preview_budget_helper.py) and the app (packages/providers/src) must both equal this file; a price change is a reviewed change to both sides and to this file. Prices are list prices in USD per million tokens. effort null means the request carries no reasoning_effort field. Per-call caps (owner ruling 2026-10-10), the same for every row: output_bound (the max_tokens ceiling and the reservation's output term) 32768 tokens, and a hard request body cap of 256 KiB (worst_case_request_bytes; story requests reach about 236 KiB at the high story size).

reservation.formula: ((request utf-8 bytes + overhead_bytes) * input price + output_bound * output price) / 1000000
